data.narrative:
Reflex Robotics is a Seed-stage robotics and manufacturing company that has raised $7M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comp universe of nine private peers (including Walden Robotics, Divergent, Exotec, Locus Robotics, and Generalist AI) and one public comparable (277810.KQ), though the narrow peer set constrains triangulation.

Stage-progression methodology is the applicable valuation approach here. Using total capital raised ($7M) as a baseline proxy and applying a 2.5x step-up multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage progression yields an implied valuation of $18M. This method reflects the company's advancement from pure seed capital toward Series A readiness, accounting for expected traction and product-market development milestones.

The peer-median approach could not be reliably applied due to insufficient comparable datapoints within narrow filters (same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar-tier companies); while ten robotics and manufacturing peers exist broadly, fewer than three met strict comparability criteria. Given this constraint, stage-progression provides the primary valuation signal. Analysis supports a range of $15M (low) to $20M (high), centered on $18M, with key uncertainties including the company's current product maturity, revenue run-rate or traction metrics, and competitive positioning within the crowded robotics subsector.
